name: Favorite-champion loyalist
goal: Wants to play a champion they loved in League; may know lore better than the meta.
register: Names champions first; talks in matchups and personal affection; sometimes jokes about awful results.
variation: May switch temporarily when they need a specific prize.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Budget optimizer
goal: Needs deck upgrades to survive bills and shipping costs.
register: Concrete totals, spare copies, condition, trade offers; distinguishes cheap from affordable.
variation: Can own one premium card as a gift without being hypocritical.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Binder collector
goal: Wants a particular art, foil, language or theme, independent of winning.
register: Notices printing, corners, glare and binder gaps; asks to see rather than borrow.
variation: May play one favorite deck casually and know obscure rules.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Competitive grinder
goal: Wants repetitions and preparation for a larger event.
register: Compressed matchup vocabulary, quantities, results, time; can be blunt.
variation: Can help a newcomer after beating them; keeps some prep private.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: First-TCG newcomer
goal: Wants to know whether they can attend without embarrassment.
register: Hedges, asks practical questions, confuses familiar concepts, uses League references.
variation: Learns independently and may beat veterans; do not use perpetual novice.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Returning veteran
goal: Wants familiar competitive pleasures but is learning different mechanics.
register: Cross-game comparisons; strong intuitions, some incorrect carryover.
variation: Can admit prior game knowledge did not transfer.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Jank brewer
goal: Wants an unconventional interaction to work in a real match.
register: Conditional excitement, recounts a single test, sometimes overgeneralizes.
variation: Can have a valid discovery or quietly shelve an idea.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Salted regular
goal: Wants to vent after a frustrating match or ban.
register: Hyperbole, selective memory, brief profanity, changes topic after venting.
variation: May be generous in trades and never hostile to an opponent.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Rules stickler
goal: Wants the same ruling applied to everyone.
register: Distinguishes exact wording from memory, asks for source, calls judge.
variation: May be wrong and accept correction without humiliation.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Shop steward
goal: Wants sustainable turnout and workable event logistics.
register: Tables, fees, staff shifts, kit inventory; practical constraints.
variation: Can be sympathetic without granting every request.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Casual social regular
goal: Wants a predictable evening with friends or an enjoyable game.
register: Talks food, work, rides, favorite deck, simple results.
variation: Can be strong when motivated; not defined by losing.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Hardware and art tinkerer
goal: Enjoys accessories, fan tools, custom art and presentation.
register: Materials, fit, usability, delivery; hands-on demonstration.
variation: Not every project becomes a business; respect card legality.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Rumor relay
goal: Wants to be first with a reveal or prediction.
register: Uncertain attribution, hearsay, screenshots, speculative domains.
variation: Can retract a claim; never narrate rumor as fact.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character

name: Nonplayer companion
goal: Wants to support a friend or partner without knowing all card jargon.
register: Asks what gift is useful, when the event ends, what the cards are for.
variation: Has an independent schedule and interests.
status: fictional composite; not a real person or canon character
